title: Perceive With Confidence
summary: 不知道“没有障碍”还是“感知没看见”

mechanisms.name: Perceive With Confidence — dtr:DR18 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: 用 conformal calibration 把 occupancy perception 与 planner 的不确定联结，为退化/分布偏移保留风险上界
mechanisms.limitations: 室内静态障碍和四足机器人；统计保证依赖校准/偏移假设，不覆盖动态 BLV 事件

mechanisms.name: Perceive With Confidence — taro:T10a route mechanism
mechanisms.description: Perceive With Confidence 已把 conformal calibration 与学习感知/规划联结；Explore until Confident 已用 multi-step conformal prediction 校准 EQA 停止。故“conformal + confidence stopping”本身不是 TARO novelty；TARO 的候选差异是 partial-metric factor posterior、body/path clearance、非对称 false-clear risk、人类取证成本和 deterministic reducer，但仍须实验证明。
mechanisms.limitations: This adjacent work constrains TARO novelty or supplies a bounded reference. Its source-domain result is not TARO task-functional identifiability, a metric anchor, O0R truth, human-constrained sensing evidence, user benefit, or safety.
